newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha touch softer, quiet in edgy market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha touch softer, quiet in edgy market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was a touch softer by 50 cents or so on Monday amid a generally easier energy complex.
"There is a feeling crude could fall, and fall by 50 cents or so," said one trader.

Cargoes were talked around $173/174 cif, but there was more interest for fob barrels and also interest for N+A barges. Talk was centred on floating rather than fixed prices with high cif quotes +$3 heard. "That seems high and I doubt anything will be done at that level," commented one dealer.
"The market is quiet and edgy, I don't think people want to expand their wet or swaps position," said anotther trader.
